svg.title: Flare SM70 speculative round time
svg.desc: Historical, older binary 2c792073: GPU step per 1 x 5 speculative round, one agent, four 16.6k to 18.6k-token prompts, Tesla V100 PCIe 32 GB, 2026-10-22: replay-commit with pre-S1L draft 55.1 ms; S1L draft without replay-commit 50.4 ms; release package with replay-commit and S1L 49.5 ms. Source: STATUS.md lines 52 and 64.
